title: Kanyini Home-Grown Skills — Marketplace Manifest
description: Top-level .claude-plugin/marketplace.json contract. Mirrors Claude Code's OWN marketplace schema: `plugins` MUST be an array of { name, source } objects. Claude Code's /plugin marketplace add rejects any other shape.
$comment: Release-train metadata (latest / yanked / deprecated, object-keyed plugins) was removed 2026-06-04. Reason: Claude Code never reads those fields, every skill is 1.0.0, and the object shape broke `/plugin marketplace add` with 'expected array, received object'. To re-introduce yank/deprecate later, add a SEPARATE release-train.json sidecar plus a custom installer that reads it — do NOT put it back in this file. Trigger to revisit: a bad version ships to an already-installed user base AND a custom installer exists.

owner.description: Marketplace owner. EMAIL FIELD INTENTIONALLY OMITTED.

plugins.description: Claude Code requires an ARRAY of plugin entries. Each entry needs name + source. Per-plugin version/deps live in plugins/<name>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, NOT here.

name.description: Skill name. Must match plugins/<name>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json name.

source.description: Relative path to the plugin folder, e.g. ./plugins/savepoint

description.description: Optional. Claude Code falls back to the plugin's own plugin.json description if omitted.
